shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat vertical face
animal or creature motifs rendered in profile
bird-like head with prominent eye and beak
motifs stacked vertically to fill the whole surface
justification: Both are tall upright stone slabs whose entire face is filled with low-relief zoomorphic imagery stacked vertically, and each includes at least one profile bird-like head with an emphasised round eye. The manner of execution is quite different, however: A isolates naturalistic, well-spaced animal figures against a blank ground within clear horizontal registers, while B is an all-over, tightly interlocking web of abstracted angular-curvilinear scrolls with no empty field or register lines.
